questions.question: Q1 (2012 PM). URTI in old guy with COPD (or a 26 week old baby in peds exam) in contact with a 2 year old who had a cold

parts.text: a) Diagnostic test will give result within 24h

cohort_answer.text: a) PCR respiratory multiplex (within 24h, covers many pathogens); culture is most sensitive but takes days; antigen detection is fastest but limited (as for influenza A/B); serologic methods also exist. Viruses: SARS-CoV-2, Influenza, Parainfluenza, Rhinovirus, Adenovirus, Enterovirus, RSV, Human metapneumovirus, OC43, bocavirus (mnemonic RAPIER: rhino, adeno, paraflu, influenza, entero, RSV, + COVID; coronaviruses more common than enterovirus).
